text:
Make a 'try again on <job>' retry keep the original request's goal and deliverables. The retry seed in crates/athena-core/src/reading/retry.rs carries the introspection's proposed_request, and readers have adopted it as the retry's whole scope. Retry 20261108-041939-fqaz of 20261108-023649-67f6 wrote 'its skill work is dropped and not retried here' and did only the formatting fix. Retry 20261109-075131-e5cg of 20261017-205554-zaj2 was 'narrowed as its introspection proposed' and left part of the original request to an unqueued follow-up. Fix: in the seed text and the reader brief, label the introspection's proposal as a prevention to add, not a replacement for the original request. Add a reading check that refuses a retry reading whose criteria drop an outcome of the original request, unless a recorded correction from the user drops it. Add a test with a fixture where the proposal is narrower than the original request; the test must fail without the change.

Acceptance:
- The change is made as described: A 'try again on' retry takes the failed job's review proposal as its scope and drops the user's original request
- No unrelated behavior changes; the existing tests pass
- fmt, clippy and test pass

Files: crates/athena-core/src/reading/retry.rs
